normalizations: Outlined PDF: original.pdf has no text layer; every Japanese line is a manual transcription from 300 dpi renders (500 dpi clips for small or ambiguous glyphs), kept as printed (source/intake.py names the physical page of each block). No Japanese wording, punctuation or spelling is changed; suspected source errors are listed in source_manifest.json:source_concerns.
Shared Manual IR: content.json is replayed through the shared flow renderer and shared components. No package class or inline style (prepared-document shared-style gate).
Print weights: bold print runs stay strong. Printed bullet (・/●/■) and number marks become lists; nested marks nest under their item. Subscripts stay subscript.
Line ends inside a paragraph are wraps; the print's explicit line breaks inside one block stay line breaks.

Figures are source panels cropped just inside the print's panel frame (the decorative frame is drawn by the shared theme); Japanese words drawn in the art stay in the art and the alt text carries them. Notes and cautions the print boxes inside a panel are shared callout strips under the figure.

Pictogram warning grids (警告/注意): each printed row becomes a shared warning/caution callout with the print's bold title and body; the row pictograms are not repeated per row (JE-1000D JP V2 precedent), their meanings are carried by the shared symbol table.
Cover and table of contents are not Web content (operator decision for this batch).
